mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message ( message_id, thread_id, role, content, status, invocation_id, task_id, agent_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{threadId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{status}, #{invocationId}, #{taskId}, #{agentId}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{updatedAt, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE thread_id = VALUES(thread_id), role = VALUES(role), content = VALUES(content), status = VALUES(status), invocation_id = VALUES(invocation_id), task_id = VALUES(task_id), agent_id = VALUES(agent_id), created_at = VALUES(created_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_message WHERE invocation_id = #{invocationId} AND role = 'ASSISTANT' ORDER BY created_at ASC, message_id ASC LIMIT 1
